IN NO EVENT SHALL THE COPYRIGHT HOLDER OR + * CONTRIBUTORS BE LIABLE FOR ANY DIRECT, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, EXEMPLARY, OR CONSEQUENTIAL + * DAMAGES (INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED TO, PROCUREMENT OF SUBSTITUTE GOODS OR SERVICES; LOSS OF USE, + * DATA, OR PROFITS; OR BUSINESS INTERRUPTION) HOWEVER CAUSED AND ON ANY THEORY OF LIABILITY, + * WHETHER IN CONTRACT, STRICT LIABILITY, OR TORT (INCLUDING NEGLIGENCE OR OTHERWISE) ARISING IN ANY + * WAY OUT OF THE USE OF THIS SOFTWARE, EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGE. + */ +package org.openjdk.jmc.ui.misc; + +import java.util.Map; +import java.util.WeakHashMap; +import java.util.function.Function; + +import org.eclipse.core.runtime.Status; +import org.eclipse.core.runtime.jobs.Job; +import org.eclipse.jface.viewers.StructuredViewer; + +/** + * This class should be used with care, so be sure to understand the semantics. It is a workaround + * for an anti pattern of doing too much heavy work during GUI rendering of label providers. + * + * 
+ * This is solved by: 
+ * 1. returning quickly with a default/fallback value 
+ * 
+ * 2. Firing off a Job in the background to do the actual work and populate a cache 
+ * 
+ * 3. Refresh the viewer for this element 
+ * 
+ * 4. The next invocation will pick up the cached value and return quickly. 
+ * 
+ * LIMITATIONS: 
+ * 
+ * 1. This only works for "static" attributes / cell values as it uses a cache internally
+ * 
+ * 2. The cache is keyed on the element object directly, so may sure the model is stable and the
+ * hashCode/equals are correct. If not the cache will not save anything
+ * 
+ * 2. It can potentially create A LOT of background jobs (as it is triggered for each hell), possibly
+ * affecting other background tasks. Therefore it is not suitable for LARGE structures. 
+ * 
+ * 3. As it is a workaround, consider if the structure can be rewritten instead, so that heavy work is done in
+ * the background and the label provider is only used for quick presentation logic.
+ *
+ * + * @param + * the element type to key the cache + * @param + * the type you want to cache, for example String, Color or Image + */ +public class DeferredLabelProvider { + private final StructuredViewer viewer; + private final Function retriever; + private final Map cache = new WeakHashMap<>(); + + public DeferredLabelProvider(StructuredViewer viewer, Function retriever) { + this.viewer = viewer; + this.retriever = retriever; + } + + public V getLabelAttribute(K element) { + if (!cache.containsKey(element)) { + Job.createSystem("Loading label attribute for " + element, monitor -> { //$NON-NLS-1$ This is technical and not displayed + if (monitor.isCanceled()) { + return Status.CANCEL_STATUS; + } + V value = retriever.apply(element); + cache.put(element, value); + // trigger refresh of view for that element + if (!this.viewer.getControl().isDisposed()) { + this.viewer.getControl().getDisplay().asyncExec(() -> this.viewer.update(element, null)); + } + return Status.OK_STATUS; + }).schedule(); + } + return cache.get(element); + } + +}
